title: Apple’s Secret 50KM Backyard Ultra Detailed!
content:
“This is not a race”- That’s the (repeated) words of the announcer at last night’s running event at Apple Campus. And I suspect those same words might have been spoken five months ago on April 1st, 2026, when a bunch of runners gathered for a 50KM event around the famed Apple campus loop (often called ‘The Spaceship’).

Now, I’ll likely expand on this post with more written details down the road, but since time is tight and the Apple Watch unveiling event starts in 9 minutes, I’ll let you watch the video I put together this morning about the secretive 50KM event that occurred a bit earlier this year.

Enjoy, thanks for reading, and stay tuned for plenty more Apple Watch details later today!
author: Ray Maker
